bangkok.tagline: Comfortable Southeast Asia hub with frequent travel options
bangkok.whoFor: Retirees who want strong value for money, private healthcare access, and an easy base for regional SE Asia travel.
mismatch: Anyone needing U.S. Medicare for routine care
bangkok.costNote: Educational snapshots aligned with the overseas hub $2M / 4% directory — not live quotes or personalized advice. Visa and tax rules change; confirm with official sources and licensed professionals.
bangkok.healthcare: Private hospitals are widely used by expats. Traditional Medicare does not cover routine care abroad — budget international private insurance and evacuation options.
bangkok.visa: Thailand long-stay and retirement-oriented pathways change over time (income proofs, stay lengths, program names). Treat this as directional research only — confirm with official Thai sources or qualified counsel.
